decisions.reason: A newly launched safety shoe line in the firm's core business is still an uncertain but cheap option to hold, since in-house production and existing distribution keep carrying costs low and one year of evidence reveals too little to justify abandoning it.

The comfort insole is a low-cost accessory that complements the core footwear, so keeping it open while demand evidence accumulates costs little, though overlap with the other new insoles slightly raises the chance of consolidation.
The supportive insole is cheap to keep and its value is still unresolved, but as one of three new insole options it is a plausible candidate for later pruning if it fails to differentiate.
The ergonomic series has its own page, signalling commitment and favourable early prospects, so the option should be held and possibly expanded rather than abandoned.
Firefighter and rescue boots open a specialised segment where certification and tender cycles mean value resolves slowly, so abandoning after one year would forfeit the option prematurely.
The moulded insole is presented on the home page as a flagship of the firm's direction, so it represents a strategic commitment with high expected value that management will keep and develop.
